svg.title: xor.ad panel — UI kit v3: the full inventory
svg.desc: A mockup, not the implementation. Real geometry: 2px frames, 4px hard offset shadows, radius 6, control height 36, the light palette's real values. v3 adds the HTML5 inventory, corrects the focus treatment (accent only) and the held state in a row (no travel).

g.text: Every control the panel has or will want, plus two corrections: focus, and what a held button does in a row.
One event, one line. The frame turns accent — nothing is drawn around it.
Was — two lines for one event
A frame and a ring around it: one event, drawn twice.
Is — the frame, and only the frame
over the 3:1 a state change needs
Applies to every focusable thing, not only fields.
Intent chooses the fill; the shadow is the same for all of them.
danger, in a row — see below
SIZE · WITH ICON · LOADING · FULL WIDTH
Full width — the only action on a phone
A BUTTON GROUP — ONE ACTION, ONE ALTERNATIVE
the quiet one first, the committing one last and right
DANGER COMES IN TWO — AND THEY ARE NOT INTERCHANGEABLE
In a row, a table, a menu. It opens a confirmation; the ellipsis says so.
Only inside a dialog, once, as the thing that does it.
Shape carries meaning: square is many, round is one, a track is on or off.
grouped by a fieldset, named by a legend
— a radio without a group is a bug
a switch acts immediately; a checkbox waits
for the form to be submitted. Never mix them.
SEGMENTED — AND THE CORRECTION YOU ASKED FOR
the chosen one sits 4px lower than its neighbours
stays — the fill carries the state
one baseline; no shadow because it is in, not on
Rule: travel belongs to :active — momentary, watched. A state that persists keeps its place and changes fill.
Same box, different jobs. Every one labelled; the placeholder only ever shows an example.
the reveal is a button inside the field,
not a second control beside it
filters as you type; the clear is always
reachable, and Esc does the same
the range is two fields with one label,
the second never earlier than the first
Two lines of a note that wraps and
counter appears past 80% of the limit
what was chosen is shown, and removable
a swatch that opens a picker
Say what happened, and what to do about it. Colour never carries the message alone.
The key is shown once. Copy it now.
This key has no origins — it will be refused.
the chosen one is weight plus a rule,
not a box — a tab is not a button
aria-selected, and the panel is labelled by it
"load older" for a log — a cursor has no
underlined always — colour alone is not a link
destructive last, after a rule, with an ellipsis
a tooltip explains; it never holds the only
Anything using it stops working at once.
numbers right and tabular; the sorted column says so in its head
WHAT IS ALREADY BUILT, AND WHAT THIS ADDS
buttons · fields · ticks · badges · table · toolbar · breadcrumb · sidebar · empty/error/loading
button intents and sizes · switch · indeterminate · password · number steppers · search clear ·
date/time · file drop · range · colour · alerts · progress/meter/skeleton · tabs · pagination ·
menu · tooltip · dialog · sortable and selectable table · tags · avatar · kbd
Mockup — panel/design/kit-mockup.svg. Nothing implemented yet; pick what is worth building and in what order.
